User-agent: *
Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=no
Allow: /

# AI *search* crawlers stay allowed: they may crawl, cite, and link to the
# site, which is exactly the audience we want (AI overviews / citations).
# The Content-Signal above opts out of AI *training* only, not search.
# Deliberate stance — see strategy doc (AI-search-first / Option A).
# Do not blanket-block these.
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /

User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Allow: /

# Google access re-enabled (the site was re-added to Google Search Console).
# Every Google Search / Images / News / Video / Ads / URL-Inspection bot now
# falls through to the "User-agent: *" group above (Allow: /), so no explicit
# Googlebot group is needed.
# Google-Extended is the one exception: it is Google's dedicated AI-*training*
# control and does NOT affect Search, so it stays blocked to preserve the
# "ai-train=no" signal above. Remove it too if you ever want Google AI
# training on this content.
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

# Block all Wayback Machine / Internet Archive crawlers
User-agent: ia_archiver
Disallow: /

User-agent: archive.org_bot
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://stlaccess.com/sitemap.xml
